$schema_note: Maps release artifacts to their Nexus Mods targets. To publish, create a GitHub Release tagged '<artifact>-v<version>' (e.g. hardest-to-be-v1.0.0). The release.yml workflow parses the tag, stages each contentDir into its installDir, zips the stage as '<fileBaseName>_v<version>.zip' so the game trees sit at the zip root, attaches the zip to the release, and uploads to Nexus. See RELEASING.md.
$paths_note: contentDir = repo folder whose CONTENTS ship. installDir = path inside the zip those contents are placed at. This mod ships three top-level game trees, so both are arrays and must pair up one to one - a single contentDir would silently drop the other two and still build a zip that looks complete. The restore-nebula-compatibility-patch artifact stages optional-files/restore-nebula-compatibility-patch/r6 as r6, so its one script lands beside the main file's.
$file_id_note: The Nexus file id is NOT stored here. It lives in a REPOSITORY VARIABLE named NEXUS_FILE_ID_HARDEST_TO_BE (and NEXUS_FILE_ID_RESTORE_NEBULA_COMPATIBILITY_PATCH for the optional file), set under Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > Variables. It does not exist until the mod's first file has been uploaded to Nexus by hand, so a committed placeholder would be a committed lie. Get it from the mod page's Files tab > 'API Info' (Nexus labels it 'Group ID'). Do NOT use the file_id from the public v1 API - that is a different id space and the wrong value looks entirely plausible.
